title: Woman's Motel Rampage Quickly Turns Wild and Disgusting
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 11, 2022, police were called to a disturbance at an Onalaska, WI motel. A guest was allegedly damaging her room and acting erratically, possibly due to substance influence. She displayed loud and agitated behavior as officers made contact with her. While being placed in the squad car, she suddenly spat on two officers. She further engaged in self-destructive behavior during transport to the jail.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
